newsitem.title: USA: American Dental sets reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: American Dental sets reverse stock split.

text.p: American Dental Technologies Inc said Friday its board had approved a one-for-four reverse stock split.
The action must be approved by stockholders.
At the end of the third quarter, the company reported 30.5 million average shares outstanding.
American Dental said it will solicit the written consent of stockholders for the reverse split instead of holding a special meeting.

The primary purpose of the reverse split is to reduce the number of authorized and outstanding shares to increase the trading price and stimulate broader investment interest, the company said. It also said stock trades in the current range of the company's common stock may not be marginable and could be subject to delisting proceedings from Nasdaq.

"ADC continues to experience strong sales in the fourth quarter," said President Ben Gallant in a statement. "We are relocating laser manufacturing to our Texas manufacturing facility. It is anticipated that the consolidation of manufacturing, together with other recently implemented cost controls, should result in operating expense savings starting in 1997.
"In light of the favorable business developments during 1996 and our expectations for 1997, ADT believes a reverse stock split should help enhance stockholder value."
American Dental develops advanced technologies for dentistry.
